raid.how_1_b: Weak points light up on the boss. Tap them fast to build a COMBO. Higher combo = bigger damage numbers.
raid.how_2_b: The boss attacks your lane. Swipe or tap left / middle / right to move before the circle fills. Getting hit breaks your combo.
raid.how_3_b: Fruit skill and sword slash have cooldowns. Every hit charges AWAKEN. When it glows purple, press it for a huge ultimate.
raid.how_4_b: Every pirate in the app hits the same boss today. When the crew finishes it, everyone who joined opens a crate. Damage = bounty = rank = PRO time.
raid.d_dough: Slow, hits like a truck. Rings of dough slam the boss.
raid.d_dragon: Highest raw power. Breathes a wall of fire.
raid.d_kitsune: Fast combos. Fox-fire orbs charge Awaken quickly.
raid.d_leopard: Speed and crits. Claw marks tear across the boss.
raid.d_spirit: Builds Awaken fastest of all fruits.
raid.d_venom: Poison ticks keep dealing damage after each hit.
raid.d_buddha: Wide hits. Hard to miss weak points.
raid.d_rumble: Chains lightning. Bosses weak to Rumble take x1.5.
raid.d_ice: Freezes the boss attack telegraph for a moment.
raid.d_light: Fastest skill cooldown in the game.
raid.d_dark: Pulls weak points together for easy taps.
